rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken equivalent, often before 都 to say that something is true worldwide.

example.english: People worldwide are watching this match.
example.jyutping: cyun4 sai3 gaai3 dou1 tai2 gan2 ni1 coeng4 bo1

rows.note: Use this when worldwide means in places throughout the world, with emphasis on different regions.

example.english: There are Hong Kong fans worldwide.
example.jyutping: sai3 gaai3 gok3 dei6 dou1 jau5 hoeng1 gong2 mai4

rows.note: This is the all-purpose casual choice for something involving the whole world.

example.english: This film will be released in cinemas worldwide.
example.traditional: 呢套戲會喺全世界嘅戲院上映。
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 hei3 wui5 hai2 cyun4 sai3 gaai3 ge3 hei3 jyun2 soeng6 jing2

rows.note: Use this for a formal or technical description of a phenomenon affecting the world as a whole.

example.english: This study shows that climate change is a worldwide problem.
example.traditional: 呢次調查顯示，氣候變化係一個全球性問題。
example.jyutping: ni1 ci3 diu6 caa4 hin2 si6 hei3 hau4 bin3 faa3 hai6 jat1 go3 cyun4 kau4 sing3 man6 tai4

rows.note: Use this when worldwide means occurring in or involving places in many parts of the world.

example.english: Restaurants worldwide have started raising their prices.
example.traditional: 世界各地嘅餐廳都開始加價。
example.jyutping: sai3 gaai3 gok3 dei6 ge3 caan1 teng1 dou1 hoi1 ci2 gaa1 gaa3
